findings.claim: The review-packet builder still uses `git diff HEAD`, which produces an empty diff for already-committed work and can silently omit the changes under review.
findings.evidence: Packet `diff_source` states: "Root cause of the empty-diff class remains build-review-packet.sh's `git diff HEAD` (c400 defect, unfixed)." The producer correction also identifies `build-review-packet.sh:196` as the source.
findings.suggested_fix: Build packets from the target commit range, e.g. `git show --stat --patch <sha>` for single commits or `git diff <base>..<head>`, and fail if the requested committed target yields an empty diff unexpectedly.

findings.claim: The recorded C-02 positive control is internally inconsistent because it lists eight secret-pattern classes but claims only a 5/5 control with one planted secret per class.
findings.evidence: D-7 lists patterns for `sk-`, `api[_-]?key`, `bearer <token>`, `token=`, `secret[_-]?key`, `ghp_…`, `AKIA…`, and private keys, then states: "one planted secret per class; it matched 5/5." Acceptance criteria 1.1 and 2.1 require the positive control to prove the scan pattern fires.
findings.suggested_fix: Either add positive-control fixtures for every listed pattern class and record the matching count accordingly, or narrow the documented pattern list to the five classes actually controlled.
